atoms.source_line: Histologically or cytologically confirmed advanced/metastatic SCLC or NSCLC
atoms.question: Is the patient diagnosed with small cell or non‑small cell lung cancer?

atoms.source_line: Histologically or cytologically confirmed advanced/metastatic SCLC or NSCLC
atoms.question: Is the disease stage advanced/metastatic (stage IV)?

atoms.source_line: Any of the following tumor tissue based genetic alterations: FGFR1, FGFR2, FGFR3, VEGFA, or PDGFRα amplification; Any FGFR1, FGFR2, or FGFR3 gene fusion; FGFR1, FGFR2, or FGFR3 activating mutation
atoms.text: FGFR1/2/3, VEGFA, or PDGFRα alteration (amplification, gene fusion, or activating mutation) present
atoms.question: Does tumor testing show any FGFR1/2/3, VEGFA, or PDGFRα alteration (amplification, fusion, or activating mutation)?

atoms.source_line: Availability of tumor tissue sample suitable for the central confirmation of the genetic alteration and exploratory analyses
atoms.text: Suitable tumor tissue sample available for central confirmation
atoms.question: Is there a tumor tissue sample suitable for central confirmation of the genetic alteration?

atoms.source_line: Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group (ECOG) of 0 or 1
atoms.question: What is the patient's ECOG performance status (must be 0 or 1)?
Does the patient have measurable disease per RECIST 1.1?

atoms.source_line: Documented radiographic disease progression following at least one line of therapy in the advanced/metastatic setting
atoms.question: Has the patient received at least one prior line of systemic therapy in the advanced/metastatic setting?

atoms.source_line: Tumors that are invading a major vessel; NSCLC tumors abutting to a major vessel
atoms.text: Tumor invading or abutting a major blood vessel
atoms.question: Is the tumor invading or abutting a major blood vessel?

atoms.source_line: Uncontrolled hypertension, defined as SBP ≥ 140 mmHg and/or DBP ≥ 90 mmHg with optimized anti-hypertensive therapy
atoms.text: Uncontrolled hypertension (SBP ≥140 mmHg or DBP ≥90 mmHg) despite optimized therapy
atoms.question: Does the patient have uncontrolled hypertension (SBP ≥140 or DBP ≥90) despite optimized therapy?

atoms.source_line: Uncontrolled hypothyroidism defined as serum thyroid stimulating hormone (TSH) higher than 5 mIU/mL while receiving appropriate thyroid hormone therapy
atoms.text: Uncontrolled hypothyroidism (TSH >5 mIU/mL while on thyroid hormone therapy)
atoms.question: Is the patient's TSH >5 mIU/mL while on thyroid hormone replacement?

atoms.source_line: Symptomatic and/or untreated central nervous system metastases
atoms.question: Does the patient have untreated or symptomatic central nervous system metastases?
Does the patient have any other active malignancy?

atoms.source_line: Ongoing adverse events from surgery or prior anti-cancer therapies, including radiation, targeted, or cytotoxic therapies
atoms.text: Ongoing adverse events from prior surgery or anti‑cancer therapies (radiation, targeted, cytotoxic)
atoms.question: Is the patient experiencing ongoing adverse events from prior surgery or anti‑cancer therapies?
Is the patient pregnant or breastfeeding?
